subject: Mathematics
chapter_title: What is Long? What is Round? Look Around
core_concepts: Identifying objects by shape and size
activities: Compare two or more objects by length
Identify objects that are long or short
Compare the height of familiar objects
Identify objects that are near or far
Compare objects as thick or thin
Compare familiar objects as heavy or light
Observe round objects in the surroundings
Experiment with objects to see which ones roll
Experiment with objects to see which ones slide
Sort familiar objects according to their observable features
learning_outcomes: Compare objects using words such as long, short, tall and near.
Identify differences in thickness and weight using everyday objects.
Recognise round objects in the surroundings.
Explore whether different objects roll or slide.
Describe and compare familiar objects using simple mathematical language.
